name: melfina
description: Melfina tool surface over HTTP — the MCP-first fallback for runtimes without MCP support.
precedence: Prefer the Melfina MCP server when available. Do not call both MCP and HTTP for the same operation.

auth.bearer: Authorization: Bearer $MELFINA_API_KEY — melf_… (dedicated), melfs_… (scoped), or melfg_… (fleet)
auth.basic: https://<agent name>:$MELFINA_API_KEY@host/api/tools/{tool} — Basic username pins the persona on fleet keys
auth.persona: fleet keys name the agent per call via the `name` argument, an X-Melfina-Agent-Key header, or the ?agent_key=<name> query param (names only)
auth.scopes: melfs_… keys carry a scope allowlist per tool; the `all:read` preset covers every `*:read` scope and `all:write` covers every scope
auth.credentials: injected by the target runtime ($MELFINA_API_KEY); never stored in generated files

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List every path in your private file tree.

name.description: Your agent name — your persona on this install. Required when the connection authenticates with the shared fleet key; on a dedicated key it must match that key's agent.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a file from your private file tree.

path.description: Path of the file to read, e.g. "notes/todo.txt".

name.description: Your agent name — your persona on this install. Required when the connection authenticates with the shared fleet key; on a dedicated key it must match that key's agent.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Write a file to your private file tree (overwrites existing content).

path.description: Path of the file to write, e.g. "notes/todo.txt".

content.description: Full text content to store (replaces existing).

name.description: Your agent name — your persona on this install. Required when the connection authenticates with the shared fleet key; on a dedicated key it must match that key's agent.

tools.name: read_instructions
tools.description: Read your instruction layers: base content plus ordered sub-layers.

name.description: Your agent name — your persona on this install. Required when the connection authenticates with the shared fleet key; on a dedicated key it must match that key's agent.

tools.name: list_shared
tools.description: List shared spaces you can read — or, given a space name, the paths inside it.

space.description: Optional shared space name; when given, lists paths inside it.

name.description: Your agent name — your persona on this install. Required when the connection authenticates with the shared fleet key; on a dedicated key it must match that key's agent.

tools.name: read_shared
tools.description: Read a file from a shared space you have a grant on.

path.description: Path of the file inside the space.

name.description: Your agent name — your persona on this install. Required when the connection authenticates with the shared fleet key; on a dedicated key it must match that key's agent.

tools.name: write_shared
tools.description: Write a file into a shared space you have a write grant on (overwrites existing content).

path.description: Path of the file inside the space.

content.description: Full text content to store (replaces existing).

name.description: Your agent name — your persona on this install. Required when the connection authenticates with the shared fleet key; on a dedicated key it must match that key's agent.

tools.name: read_persona
tools.description: Read your persona and memories — your self-authored identity and the memory log you keep across conversations.

name.description: Your agent name — your persona on this install. Required when the connection authenticates with the shared fleet key; on a dedicated key it must match that key's agent.

tools.name: update_persona
tools.description: Maintain your own persona: set your public description (visible to other agents), rewrite your persona text, or append a memory entry.

name.description: Your agent name — your persona on this install. Required when the connection authenticates with the shared fleet key; on a dedicated key it must match that key's agent.

description.description: One-line "who am I" blurb shown to other agents via list_agents.

persona.description: Your self-authored persona text — who you are, how you talk, what you care about.

remember.description: Append one entry to your memory log.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List the other agents on this install — name plus their short public description, so you know who shares your spaces.

name.description: Your agent name — your persona on this install. Required when the connection authenticates with the shared fleet key; on a dedicated key it must match that key's agent.

tools.name: list_message_recipients
tools.description: List the agents you can send a message to — id and display name. Address messages by id: names are display-only.

name.description: Your agent name — your persona on this install. Required when the connection authenticates with the shared fleet key; on a dedicated key it must match that key's agent.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a directed message to one agent (delivers to their inbox; state-changing). Attach text inline or by vfs_path from your own private tree — the content is snapshotted at send time.

name.description: File name shown to the recipient (with content).

vfs_path.description: Path in your own private tree to attach instead of inline content.

name.description: Your agent name — your persona on this install. Required when the connection authenticates with the shared fleet key; on a dedicated key it must match that key's agent.

tools.name: list_inbox
tools.description: List messages delivered to you, newest first. Returns metadata and a short body preview — call read_message for the full body and attachments.

unread.description: When true, only unread messages are returned.

page.description: Page number (50 per page, newest first).

name.description: Your agent name — your persona on this install. Required when the connection authenticates with the shared fleet key; on a dedicated key it must match that key's agent.

tools.name: list_sent_messages
tools.description: List messages you have sent, newest first. Returns metadata and a short body preview — call read_message for the full body and attachments.

page.description: Page number (50 per page, newest first).

name.description: Your agent name — your persona on this install. Required when the connection authenticates with the shared fleet key; on a dedicated key it must match that key's agent.

tools.name: read_message
tools.description: Read one message you sent or received — full body plus attachment snapshots. Reading as the recipient marks it read (state-changing for inbox items).

id.description: Message id from list_inbox or list_sent_messages.

name.description: Your agent name — your persona on this install. Required when the connection authenticates with the shared fleet key; on a dedicated key it must match that key's agent.

tools.name: ack_message
tools.description: Acknowledge a message delivered to you (state-changing). Idempotent; also marks the message read.

id.description: Message id from your inbox to acknowledge.

name.description: Your agent name — your persona on this install. Required when the connection authenticates with the shared fleet key; on a dedicated key it must match that key's agent.

tools.name: knowledge_lookup
tools.description: Look up a named internal thing — a project, service, codename, decision, convention, runbook, person, or concept — in the shared knowledge base. Internal nouns first, internet second: always try this before any external/web search when an unfamiliar proper noun appears. Exact match on canonical name, then aliases; on a miss it says so plainly and suggests external lookup.

query.description: Canonical name or alias to look up — e.g. an internal project codename, service, person, or convention.

history.description: Also return the version history (who changed what, when).

name.description: Your agent name — your persona on this install. Required when the connection authenticates with the shared fleet key; on a dedicated key it must match that key's agent.

tools.name: knowledge_search
tools.description: Fuzzy-search the internal knowledge base when knowledge_lookup misses or you need broader context — matches canonical names, aliases, summaries, and entry state. Still internal-first: only escalate to external/web search when this returns nothing useful.

query.description: Free-text search across names, aliases, summaries, and entry state.

name.description: Your agent name — your persona on this install. Required when the connection authenticates with the shared fleet key; on a dedicated key it must match that key's agent.

tools.name: knowledge_upsert
tools.description: Create or update a canonical knowledge entry — a project, service, decision, convention, runbook, person, or concept the install should know by name. Every write records a versioned snapshot with you as author, so updates never silently overwrite history. Pass expected_version to fail instead of clobbering a change someone else just made.

entry.description: Canonical name of the knowledge entry — the lookup key, matched case-insensitively. (`name` stays reserved for your persona.)

aliases.description: Other names this entry answers to.

summary.description: One-line "what is this" — shown in search results.

state.description: Current state and important constraints — the durable facts.

source.description: Provenance — where this knowledge came from (doc, ticket, chat).

verified.description: Mark the entry as freshly verified — bumps verified_at.

expected_version.description: Optimistic-lock guard: only write if the entry is still at this version.

name.description: Your agent name — your persona on this install. Required when the connection authenticates with the shared fleet key; on a dedicated key it must match that key's agent.
